explorer.noDatabases: No databases visible to this user

deleteConnection.title: Delete “{{name}}”?

connection.sqlserverNote: SQL Server support is planned for the next milestone.
connection.name: Name

connection.passwordWillClear: The saved password will be removed when you save.

tlsMode.verify-full: Verify full — also verify the host name

connection.readOnlyHint: The server rejects every write made through this connection.

connection.prodWarning: Production: consider enabling the read-only session.
connection.reviewRowsHint: Saves that touch more rows than this, and every delete, are previewed before they run. Production connections are always previewed.

welcome.title: Welcome to PuriCat
welcome.subtitle: A calm, spreadsheet-native home for your databases.
welcome.noRecent: Connections you open will appear here.
welcome.statusNote: PuriCat is being built in phases. Nothing below is simulated.

features.connections: Saved connections with passwords in the system keychain
features.engines: MySQL and PostgreSQL, with TLS and server-enforced read-only sessions
features.browse: Explore databases, schemas, tables and views across several servers at once
features.grid: Fast virtualized data grid with sorting, paging and exact server-side values
features.themes: Light and dark themes, English and Thai
features.editing: Excel-style editing with staged changes, plus Smart Paste: previewed INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT from a spreadsheet, matched on a key
features.sql: SQL editor with completion and formatting, cancellable runs, history, and CSV / JSON / XLSX export
features.ai: AI agent through your own Claude Code CLI (Codex not yet verified): it can look things up when you allow it, and every change waits for your approval

table.notConnectedBody: Connect to “{{name}}” to load this table.
table.missingConnectionBody: The tab points to a connection that was deleted.
table.unordered: No primary key — server order, paging may shift

readOnlyReason.noKey: This table has no primary key, so rows cannot be edited safely.
readOnlyReason.session: This connection uses a read-only session.

notEditable.column: This column cannot be edited (generated by the server, or binary).
notEditable.truncated: This value is too long for the preview and cannot be edited here yet.
notEditable.deleted: This row is marked for deletion. Restore it to edit.
notEditable.key: This row cannot be identified by its primary key.

table.dirtyLocked: Save or discard your changes first
table.unsavedBlocks: This connection has tabs with unsaved changes or an open transaction. Save, discard or end them first.

filter.title: Filter
filter.notApplied: Not applied yet — press ↵ or Apply
filter.noMatchBody: Change the conditions, or clear the filter to see every row.

ai.title: AI agent
ai.checkFailed: Could not check for the CLI
ai.checkFailedBody: Use “Check again” at the top of this panel.
ai.notInstalledBody: PuriCat talks to the {{name}} command-line tool that you install and sign in to yourself.
ai.signedOutBody: Run “{{command}}” in a terminal, then check again.
ai.modelHint: The model that answers. “Default” leaves the choice to the CLI's own settings.
ai.modelCustomHint: Any model name the CLI accepts. Enter to use it, Esc to cancel.
ai.sendHint: Send (Enter). Shift+Enter starts a new line.
ai.stopped: Stopped before the answer was complete.
ai.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
ai.openInQueryHint: Opens this SQL in a new query tab. Nothing runs until you run it.
ai.emptyBody: Get SQL drafted, a query explained or an error diagnosed. You decide what runs.

suggestions.explain: Explain what the tables in this database are for and how they relate.
suggestions.recent: Write a query that shows the 20 most recent rows of the main table.
suggestions.faster: Review the query in my active tab and suggest how to make it faster.

ai.contextHint: What the AI is told about your database

contextMissingBody.noTab: Open a table or a query tab to give the AI the schema of that database. Without one, it answers from general knowledge only.
contextMissingBody.closed: This connection is closed. Connect to it to share its schema.
contextMissingBody.noDatabase: This query tab has no database selected. Choose one in the tab to share its schema.

ai.contextBody: The names and types of the tables and columns in the active tab's database, and the SQL in the active query tab. Never rows, host names, user names or passwords.
ai.contextOffBody: Nothing about your database is sent. The AI answers from your messages only.
ai.contextFailed: The schema could not be read from this connection.
ai.policy1: The AI cannot touch your database: it has no tools here and only writes text.
ai.policy2: SQL it suggests runs only when you open it in a query tab and run it yourself.
ai.policy3: Only schema names and types, and the active query, are shared. Never rows, hosts, user names or passwords.

policyAccess.schema: The AI can look at the structure of the database in front of you: tables, columns, types and keys. It cannot read rows.
policyAccess.data: The AI can look at the structure of the database in front of you and run read-only queries on it.

ai.policyApprove: It cannot change anything by itself. A change is a proposal: you read the SQL and decide, and PuriCat runs it only if you approve.
ai.policyShareRows: What it reads, rows included, is sent to the provider under your own account. Hosts, user names and passwords never are.

access.hint: What the AI may do with your database
access.title: Database tools
access.body: The AI can be given tools for the database of the tab in front. It can never change anything by itself: changes are proposals that you approve.

none.label: Off
none.body: The AI only writes text. It sees what the context shares and looks at nothing itself.

schema.label: Structure
schema.body: It can list tables and read their columns, types, defaults and keys, and propose changes for you to approve.

data.label: Structure and rows
data.body: It can also run read-only queries. The rows it reads are sent to the provider: at most 200 per query, in a read-only transaction.

access.noTab: Open a table or a query tab: the tools work on the database of the tab in front.
access.production: The tab in front is a Production connection. Rows the AI reads from it are sent to the provider.
access.codex: Not yet verified with Codex: its tool calls could not be tested on a working account. Claude Code is verified.

failed.describe_table: Could not read the structure of

tool.answeredError: The error the AI was given
tool.noAnswer: It did not get an answer.

proposal.title: Proposed change
proposal.rejectedNote: You rejected this. Nothing was run.
proposal.noTarget: This was proposed without a database tab in front, so it cannot be run from here.
proposal.closed: “{{name}}” is not connected. Connect to it to run this.
proposal.heldBack_one: Rolled back: it would have changed {{count}} row, more than this connection's limit.
proposal.heldBack_other: Rolled back: it would have changed {{count}} rows, more than this connection's limit.
proposal.skipped_one: {{count}} statement after it was not run.
proposal.skipped_other: {{count}} statements after it were not run.
proposal.leftOpen: The script left a transaction open. It was rolled back.
proposal.reviewBody: Read the SQL. If you approve, PuriCat runs exactly this on the connection below. The AI does not run it.
proposal.guardNote_one: A statement that changes more than {{count}} row is rolled back, and you are asked again.
proposal.guardNote_other: A statement that changes more than {{count}} rows is rolled back, and you are asked again.
proposal.orderNote: Statements run one after another, each committed on its own. The first error stops the rest.
proposal.liftTitle: Run it without the row limit?
proposal.liftBody_one: This statement changes {{count}} row. It was rolled back because that is more than this connection's limit.
proposal.liftBody_other: This statement changes {{count}} rows. It was rolled back because that is more than this connection's limit.
proposal.liftRest_one: The {{count}} statement after it runs too, also without the row limit.
proposal.liftRest_other: The {{count}} statements after it run too, also without the row limit.

log.title: AI activity log
log.body: Every query the AI ran to read rows, every change it proposed and what you decided. Kept on this computer only; password literals are masked.
log.emptyBody: When the AI reads rows or proposes a change, it is recorded here.
log.failed: The log could not be read
log.clearConfirm: Delete every entry of the log? This cannot be undone.

errors.startupBody: The local settings store could not be opened.
errors.notInApp: This page is the PuriCat interface. Open it through the PuriCat app (pnpm tauri dev), not a web browser.

review.title: Review changes to {{name}}
review.transaction: All statements run in one transaction. If any of them fails or a row was changed by someone else, nothing is saved.
review.prodWarning: You are about to change a PRODUCTION database.

closeDirty.title: Discard changes to “{{name}}”?
closeDirty.body: This tab has edits that have not been saved to the database.
closeDirty.bodySql: Closing the tab rolls back everything in the transaction that has not been committed.

smart.openHint: Insert, update or upsert rows pasted from a spreadsheet, or read from a CSV or Excel file
smart.title: Smart Paste into {{name}}
smart.emptyBody: Copy a range of cells in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers and press “Read clipboard”, or open a CSV or Excel file.
smart.storedValues: Cells are read as their stored values: 0.5 for a cell shown as 50%.
smart.tooManyTitle: Too many rows for one run
smart.tooManyBody: The file has {{total}} rows. One run takes at most {{limit}}, in a single transaction. Split the file into smaller ones.
smart.source: {{rows}} data rows · {{columns}} columns from the clipboard
smart.nullText: Read the text NULL as an empty (NULL) value

modeHint.insert: Add every pasted row as a new row.
modeHint.update: Change rows that already exist. Pasted rows without a match are skipped.
modeHint.upsert: Change rows that already exist and add the rest as new rows.

smart.keyNone: Do not check for existing rows
smart.noKey: To match existing rows, map every column of the primary key or of a unique index.
smart.generatedKey: Rows with an empty key are added as new rows; rows whose key is not found are skipped.
smart.semantics: PuriCat matches the rows itself, then runs plain INSERT and UPDATE statements in one transaction. It does not use ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, ON CONFLICT or MERGE, so only the key chosen here decides which row is the same.
smart.stale: The set-up changed. Preview again before running.
smart.rowsShown: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows. All of them are checked.
smart.fixFirst: Fix the rows marked in red in the spreadsheet, copy again and re-read the clipboard.
smart.nothing: Nothing to do: no pasted row would be inserted or changed.

sql.needConnection: Connect to a database first, then open a query tab.
sql.runHint: Run the selection, or the whole script (⌘↵)
sql.placeholder: Write SQL here. ⌘↵ runs the selection, or the whole script.
sql.capped: Showing the first {{rows}} rows; the query was stopped there. Raise “Rows per result” to see more.
sql.noResults: Run a query to see its results here.
sql.blocked: This statement would change {{rows}} rows, more than this connection's limit of {{limit}}. It was rolled back; nothing changed.
sql.limitHint: The limit is “Review larger saves” in the connection's settings.
sql.inTransaction: Transaction open — COMMIT or ROLLBACK to end it
sql.databaseLocked: End the open transaction (COMMIT or ROLLBACK) before switching database.
sql.confirmBody: Check what they will do before they run on {{name}}.
sql.confirmProd: This is a PRODUCTION connection: every statement that can change data is listed.
sql.historyEmpty: Queries you run on this connection appear here.
sql.exportedCapped: Only the rows that were fetched were exported; the result was capped.
